detailed_descriptions_html.en:
A microphone is required to play MIMESIS.

For a more immersive experience, we recommend using a headset or earphones instead of speakers.

================================================

Do you see this message? You’ve reached the tram. Welcome.

Mimesis

Mimesis will imitate you and your allies perfectly. Behavior, voice, anything humans can do. 

Always doubt the person in front of you.

Gather four

You’ll need allies. Three is too few. Five is too many.

Survive

The danger isn’t only Mimesis.

Cursed rain may fall, or monsters may appear. Stay alive, together.

Repair the tram

It’s old. It could break anytime. Collect scraps. Fix it when you can.

Simple, right?

Stay alive as long as you can.

Key Features

  • An enemy that mimics you – Mimesis copies your voice, behavior, even your memories. Can you tell what’s real and what’s not?

  • Up to 4 player coop survival – Repair the tram and survive together. But no one knows if trust will last until the end.

  • Unpredictable horror – Every run brings new threats and changing environments. Collect scraps and escape before it’s too late.

Join Our Team

Follow us on Steam and join our official Discord. Find allies to play, survive, and talk with.
